page.overview:
Who is Caledor the Conqueror?

For the High Elf Archmage of the same name who was Caledor the Conqueror's grandsire, see Caledor Dragontamer.

Caledor the Conqueror, who reigned as Caledor I, born Imrik, son of Menieth and remembered as "Caledor the Traitor" among the Druchii, was the third Phoenix King of the High Elves, the Prince of Caledor and one of their greatest generals. He also served as one of the Dragon Riders of Caledor.

Caledor the Conqueror's mount was Maedrethnir, a blood red Dragon who was the son of Indraugnir.

Caledor was the grandson of Caledor Dragontamer (from whom he took his regnal name) and father of Caledor II and Imladrik.
